[SWS_PHM_00237] Switch Global Supervision Status from kDEACTI- VATED to kFAILED
⌈
If the Global Supervision Status is kDEACTIVATED, the
Elementary Supervision Status of at least one Alive, Deadline or Logical Su-
pervision is kFAILED and no supervision is in Elementary Supervision Sta-
tus kEXPIRED, then the Platform Health Management shall change the Global
Supervision Status to kFAILED.
⌋
